items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] There are people like Doc Cheatham and Money Johnson. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yes, I know. Yes, it gets scarce.

ctx.x: I know. Snookey is a good man.
There are people like Doc Cheatham and Money Johnson. But there are very few left. Pat Jenkins.

Yes, I know. Yes, it gets scarce. Very scarce. People like Emmett Berry, Charlie Shavers. Some of them it just didn't seem to me that they are still not here. You know, like as healthy as Red Allen was at the Metropole and as good natured, a good kind of guy he was it just doesn't seem like things like that could happen, but they do. And frankly, I feel great right now, but maybe a couple of years ago I wasn't feeling so
